project.name: Geckura
project.description: Geckura is a Solana NFT ecosystem focused on building long-term utility through NFTs, community engagement, reward systems, and Web3 applications. The ecosystem includes NFT collections, a utility token, Mystery Boxes, staking, a Trait Shop, and white-label services for other projects.

faq.question: What is Geckura?
faq.answer: Geckura is a Solana NFT ecosystem focused on building utilities, rewards, and community-driven experiences.

faq.question: How many NFT collections does Geckura have?
faq.answer: Geckura currently has two collections: Geckura Elixir (300 supply) and the Geckura PFP Collection (666 supply).

faq.question: How is the PFP collection allocated?
faq.answer: 333 paid mint, 150 reserved for Elixir holders, 150 free mints for Solana communities, and 66 reserved for the team, treasury, partnerships, and marketing.

faq.question: What is GECKURA?
faq.answer: GECKURA is the ecosystem's non-LP reward and utility token.

faq.question: Can anyone earn GECKURA?
faq.answer: Yes. Anyone can join the community and earn GECKURA through participation.

faq.question: Do I need an NFT to earn GECKURA?
faq.answer: No. NFT ownership is not required to earn GECKURA.

faq.question: What can GECKURA be used for?
faq.answer: GECKURA can be used for Mystery Boxes and future ecosystem utilities.

faq.question: Is GECKURA tradable?
faq.answer: No. GECKURA is a non-LP ecosystem reward token.

faq.question: How much does a Mystery Box cost?
faq.answer: There is no fixed price. Each Mystery Box has its own price based on its rewards and event.

faq.question: What rewards can Mystery Boxes contain?
faq.answer: Rewards may include GECKURA, Free Mints, NFTs, collectibles, event rewards, and future ecosystem utilities.

faq.question: Why should I buy a Geckura NFT?
faq.answer: NFT holders receive staking rewards, exclusive campaigns, Trait Shop access, Mystery Box opportunities, future utilities, and other holder-only benefits.

faq.question: Will staking be available?
faq.answer: Yes. NFT staking is a planned utility.

faq.question: Will there be a Trait Shop?
faq.answer: Yes. Holders will be able to customize their NFTs with collectible traits.

faq.question: Does Geckura provide services to other projects?
faq.answer: Yes. Geckura offers white-label services including Mystery Boxes, reward systems, and custom integrations.
